answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 89 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is recorded against the dune challenge, the haven audit can replay the sparrow history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 4748 identities would post 4552 proofs and burn roughly 64 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
